text:
marie: Heads-up: nightly linkcheck failed on localized site — fragment missing in /es/guide/#install-screenshot.

alex: seeing same locally. mkdocs HTML shows id `install-screenshot-1` while link points to `#install-screenshot`. Suspect slug dedupe when same image filename exists in multiple locales.

sam: CI excerpt: 
ERROR: Fragment not found: /es/guide/#install-screenshot
ERROR: Internal redirect: /guide/ -> /es/guide/ (redirected to itself)

priya: redirect issue likely from mkdocs-i18n + redirects plugin when site_url/base have trailing slash — that one is easy: normalize site_url (no trailing slash). For the fragment: short-term we can relax linkcheck to accept `(-\d+)?` suffixes so CI doesn't flake.

marie: okay plan: (1) relax linkcheck to unblock CI, (2) add a lint that warns about duplicate auto-generated anchors across locale dirs, (3) doc note recommending explicit anchors for important screenshots.

alex: I'll add the contributing blurb and an example anchor snippet in the same change as the linkcheck tweak. Keeps authors from hitting this.

sam: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/433 "lint: detect duplicated autogenerated anchors across locales" and a tiny grep-based pre-PR checker prototype.

docs-ci-bot: nightly/docs-linkcheck failed (https://ci.redwood.ai/build/8951) :x: | job: docs-linkcheck | 10m

priya: I'll open a small PR with the linkcheck regex tweak + unit tests. Will mark as hotfix to land quickly. Longer-term we should make id generation deterministic across locales or emit fragment mapping files.

marie: thanks everyone. Tag me on the PRs; we'll coordinate merge window so release docs aren't blocked. If more failures show up after the tweak, we'll run a docs triage session. :thumbsup:
